newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble slips as banks cash in before T-bill sales.
newsitem.headline: Rouble slips as banks cash in before T-bill sales.

text.p: The rouble slipped on the interbank market on Tuesday following a fall in overnight credit rates after banks had bought all the roubles they needed for Wednesday's Treasury bill auctions, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jan 28 midday Jan 28 early Jan 27 close

"The high rate of interbank credit at the beginning of the day is traditional for the start of the week before Wednesday's T-bill auction," said Alexander Suchkov, chief dealer at United Investment Bank.
The finance ministry decided on Tuesday to auction two new 4.00 trillion rouble tranches of existing T-bills on Wednesday instead of the planned 7.00 trillion rouble auction of new paper.
